A 22-year-old Nepali man returned to the village where he grew up, perched above the Trishuli River, only to find that his home was gone after devastating flash floods swept through the area last week. Rohit Tamang watched helplessly when the waters surged, washing away all that he knew. He showed CBS News’ @Ramy Inocencio the spot where his house once stood, saying he returned “because my childhood memories are here.” Tamang lost everything in the floods, but his family survived and is accounted for. #news #nepal #flood #asia #world

🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. Information about her parents remained unclear following the rescue, which has become a powerful moment of hope amid the devastating floods that have claimed numerous lives across Nepal. #Nepal #Rasuwa #Rescue #Floods #SurvivalStory

A heartbreaking moment has emerged from the devastating floods in Nepal after a woman was rescued by the Nepal Army from a flood-hit area. After being brought to safety, she was seen sitting in shock, struggling to process the destruction around her. She had survived the dangerous floodwaters, but the disaster had left her facing the painful reality of losing everything she had. The emotional scene reflects the devastating impact of the floods on ordinary families across Nepal. For many survivors, escaping the water is only the beginning of a long and difficult journey to rebuild their lives. Her silent expression says what words cannot—survival can come with an unimaginable cost. 💔🙏🇳🇵 #NepalFlood #NepalArmy #FloodRescue #Humanity #BetterFromNepal Follow BetterFromNepal for more such stories.
